history.summary: Five critical acceptance criteria not met: ty static analysis not configured (Criterion 2), no management command tests (Criterion 4), no post-deployment smoke check workflow (Criterion 9), no GitHub ruleset created (Criterion 10), no GitHub issue for static-media reduction (Criterion 13). Core modernization work is excellent but these blockers prevent PASS.

All five iteration 1 blockers fixed. ty configured with Django-aware warning handling (40 diagnostics, 0 errors). Management tests cover publishstatic with mock subprocess. Smoke workflow correctly triggers via repository_dispatch + manual dispatch. GitHub ruleset 21237273 protects main with Lint+Test CI checks. GitHub issue #335 comprehensively documents static-media reduction. Local quality gate passes: 18 tests, 68% coverage. Production-ready.

app.json now includes heroku-buildpack-django-sass matching live app. Smoke workflow upgraded to workflow_run primary trigger (fires automatically after CI) with 90-second Heroku deployment wait + 3-attempt retry logic for health checks. copilot-instructions improved with pipeline ID (de4cf89d-89a1-444d-813e-506da286d905), explicit auto-deploy steps, Review App creation instructions, and stack/buildpack details. All 14 acceptance criteria remain met. Local quality gate passes: 18 tests, 68% coverage. Zero regressions. Production-ready for immediate deployment.
